description: First-move advice for an open-ended marketing ask: looks at what GooseWorks already knows and at the site, asks at most five plain questions, names the one thing in the way, and recommends the first one or two moves. Use when the marketer says "help me with marketing", "where do I start", "we need more customers", "sales are flat", "what should I focus on this month", or "I'm back, what's next?". Recommends only; never runs the work. Not for a named job like "make me ads" (go straight to it); not for why this week's numbers moved — use analyze-performance.
